sources.fact: LBBD73/CI Thames Road is 2.6ha, deliverable=yes, mixed ownership, minimum 1,844 and maximum 3,344 net dwellings, with planning-permission-status pending-decision.
The wider-site record explicitly notes several sites pending decision including 21/01232/FULL and 22/02211/FULL; those references are components within a larger allocation.
21/01232/FULL at 7 Thames Road proposed 131 residential units plus industrial space; Planning Committee delegated authority to grant subject to Mayor direction, S106 completion and conditions.

The committee resolution allowed refusal/extension/referral if the legal agreement was not completed by the stated deadline, so committee resolution is not treated as evidence of final issued permission.
22/02211/FULL at 13-15A Thames Road proposed 245 new residential units plus 2,714 sqm GIA industrial floorspace.
Planning Committee delegated authority to grant 22/02211/FULL subject to Mayor direction, S106 completion and conditions, with a fallback deadline for refusal/extension/referral.
The 14 March 2022 Planning Committee minutes identify 21/01232/FULL as the 7 Thames Road case and keep it separate from other applications heard that night.
The 17 July 2023 Planning Committee agenda identifies 22/02211/FULL as the 13-15A Thames Road case; it is a discrete case, not the complete CI allocation.
The adopted Local Plan 2037 provides the policy framework for the Thames Road transformation area but does not convert wider allocation capacity into consented units.
Applications are assessed against the development plan; plan status remains distinct from case-level permission and S106 completion.
LBBD's application/decision service remains the case-specific route for final status; this wave does not infer final notices from committee recommendations alone.
Planning Data supports discovery and spatial filtering but does not make a wider allocation point equivalent to component red-line polygons or HMLR titles.

examples.result: 21/01232/FULL remains bound to 7 Thames Road only.
22/02211/FULL remains bound to 13-15A Thames Road only.
Delegated authority to grant subject to S106 is not silently upgraded to a final issued permission.
Mixed ownership is not converted to a single owner or title.
Deliverable=yes does not prove construction or consent across the wider allocation.
Wider-site point/capacity is not substituted for component red-line geometry.
Promotion remains zero until exact current case notices, site/title relations and statutory overlays are verified.
